meta.title: A lower price with a higher tax: screen L1 and report "best net price" may differ
gaps: The setup provides one line item, not line 2.
Only two vendors are available; vendor C cannot be represented.
Bid tax rates and tax-inclusive net prices cannot be set or read.
The report's best net price is not exposed by any operation or read-back field.

warnings: verify 1: read_indicators's reply shape has not been sampled; "auction_identifiers_data.{{vendorUuid}}.inline.{{lineItemUuid}}.rank.best_bidder" is unverified

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event with two QA vendors invited, each with a submitted bid; bidding still open.
steps: The buyer reads the round's comparison (ranks, best bidder).
As the buyer, read the round's comparison (ranks, best bidder) and check that “auction identifiers data › QA vendor 1 › inline › the line › rank › best bidder” equals {{vendorUuid}}.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: “auction identifiers data › QA vendor 1 › inline › the line › rank › best bidder” equals {{vendorUuid}}.
